strategy.reason: Block_reassign can shift multiple duties off the most over-assigned nurses (especially Stefaan/Nguyen) to nurses with remaining capacity (e.g., Patrick/Andrea/Sara at max_total but not over), potentially also reducing weekend overages if weekend duties are moved, while keeping day-level coverage intact.
strategy.avoid: Avoid coverage_fill (adds work to an already over-max system) and avoid block_swap patterns that previously introduced illegal_succession and large consecutive_cost increases.
